Subject: MAP Kickoff: Redwood + Orion Systems (draft)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the great discovery today — really helpful to hear more about Orion's latency and data residency constraints. Per our conversation, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft with milestones, responsibilities, and two timeline options. Please review and confirm the stakeholders below and pick the timeline that best fits your procurement/IT cycles.

High-level milestones (draft):
- Discovery recap & success criteria (owner: Jordan) — 1 week
- Security/compliance review (owner: Maya/IT) — 2 weeks
- Pilot environment setup (owner: Redwood infra eng, contact: Rishi) — 3 weeks
- Pilot validation & acceptance tests (joint) — 2 weeks
- Procurement/contracting (owner: Orion procurement) — concurrent with pilot
- GA rollout / production cutover (owner: Orion + Redwood) — target close

Timeline options (pick one):
- Option A (Aggressive): 6 weeks — Target close: 2026-11-30
- Option B (Conservative): 9 weeks — Target close: 2026-12-21

Dependencies / Notes:
- Data residency: need confirmation if Orion requires EU-only or US-only region for pilot/GA.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys; please confirm key provider and contact.
- Procurement: if a PO is required, please share procurement lead and expected cadence.

Attachments:
- 20261018-Orion-MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP with milestone columns)
- SOW-template-v2.pdf (standard SOW template)

Links:
- MAP doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Orion-MAP-draft
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ORN-2026-045

Ask:
- Can you confirm the primary stakeholders (security, procurement, technical lead)?
- Which timeline option do you prefer?
- Are you available for a MAP kickoff call next Wed or Thu morning PT? (propose 10am PT Wed 10/21)

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Marissa,

Thanks — this looks like a great starting point. Confirming stakeholders:

- Sasha Kim (Procurement) — sasha.kim@orionsys.com

I'm available for kickoff Wed 10/21 at 10am PT. If you can send a calendar invite and an updated MAP with the residency note that'd be great.
